# Template: food_web
A food web laid out in horizontal trophic bands, producers at the bottom rising through primary and secondary consumers to apex predators at the top: each organism is a name in an ellipse halo, and each link in "grass -> rabbit" notation (A is eaten by B) draws an arrow from A up to B, following energy flow up the food chain. An organism named in `highlight` gets its direct links tinted. Choose this scene for ANY request about a food web, a food chain, trophic levels, producers and consumers, predator-prey relationships, or "what eats what" in an ecosystem.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "organisms": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "name": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "level": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
       "producer",
       "primary",
       "secondary",
       "apex"
      ],
      "description": "Trophic level; unspecified/other levels default to primary consumer."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "name"
    ]
   },
   "description": "The organisms in the web (default: a grass/rabbit/mouse/fox/hawk web)."
  },
  "links": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "kit.parseEdgeList notation, \"grass -> rabbit; rabbit -> fox\" — A -> B means A is eaten by B."
  },
  "highlight": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "An organism's name; tints its direct links (predator and prey links both)."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- org_<slug>: an organism's name in its ellipse halo (one group)
- link_<i>: the i-th parsed link's upward arrow (A eaten by B, drawn from A to B)
- band_label_<k>: the trophic-band caption (k = 0 producers, 1 primary, 2 secondary, 3 apex)
Examples:
Request: "Draw a food web with grass, rabbits, mice, foxes and hawks." → params: {}
Request: "Draw a food web and highlight what happens to the fox's links." → params: {"organisms":[{"name":"Grass","level":"producer"},{"name":"Rabbit","level":"primary"},{"name":"Fox","level":"secondary"}],"links":"Grass -> Rabbit; Rabbit -> Fox","highlight":"Fox"}

In YAML: `template: food_web` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
